Description
Our client is a retail group headquartered in Amsterdam with around 430 fashion and home stores in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and France. Its portfolio of roughly 600 store leases is still accounted for in spreadsheets. The group wants to move to a dedicated lease accounting solution before the 2026 year-end audit and needs an experienced IFRS 16 specialist to lead the accounting side of this project.

Responsibilities
- Own the IFRS 16 accounting for the lease portfolio during the project, including remeasurements for index-linked rents, lease modifications and terminations
- Define the accounting requirements and the data model for the new lease tool and validate the migrated contracts
- Prepare the impairment testing of right-of-use assets together with group controlling (IAS 36)
- Write accounting memos and the lease accounting policy, and align positions with the external auditor
- Train the local accounting teams in the four countries

Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in IFRS accounting, ideally in retail or real estate
- Proven track record in IFRS 16 implementations or remediation projects
- Experience with a lease accounting tool (for example LeaseAccelerator, Nakisa or SAP RE-FX)
- Big Four background is a plus
- Fluent English; Dutch or German is helpful but not required

Working conditions
The assignment is fully remote. You can work from anywhere in the EU as long as you are available during Central European business hours. Travel to Amsterdam is optional; if you join workshops on site, travel costs are reimbursed. We contract freelancers directly (B.V., GmbH, Ltd. or sole trader).
